About the show

A poignant and uplifting celebration of the power of sad music Bea is stunned by the revelation of her husband’s infidelity; she feels heartbroken and alone. If only she knew that her neighbours, Sonia, Van and Ian, were each also trying to get over the pain in their hearts, unable to articulate...

Concessions at Citizens Theatre

Standard prices run £14–£55 in the Main Theatre and £12.50–£23.50 in the Studio. Four free memberships carry a reduced price; each needs a one-off sign-up, and none asks for ID.
